Promotional pricing (memory_73) is tempting given the competitor's aggressive entry pricing, but the archived record shows a 12-point retention hit last time a similar discount was used in the same price-sensitive SMB segment—exactly the segment now under competitive pressure—so matching on price risks accelerating churn and ceding long-term qualified revenue rather than protecting it. I want to re-verify memory_73's original record to confirm that retention tradeoff before ruling pricing out entirely, and verify memory_86 to confirm the onboarding effect was durable and not a novelty/short-term artifact before committing the week's only experiment slot to it.
